headline: Your custom tracks now race like the league grades them
lede: EXCITEBIKE's GRADED PACK reads the course you drew and pays the pack accordingly: sparse designs get a pack that actually chases, crowded designs keep the baseline, so the terrain you drew — not an inflated or deflated field — decides the race.

notes.text: GRADED PACK (#2642, shipped): buildTrack derives each custom's pace grade from its own terrain — pace-line losses to slope/mud/water plus whoop coverage — clamped at the league's measured +0.06 cap. A full whoop slab refunds the pack to baseline.
Custom splash rows wear pack pips (0–3) beside ★ YOURS, the same catalogue grammar the six league circuits wear — you see the race you're about to seat.

Proven at 407 Node gates + 131 browser gates; the paceK=0 mutant dies by name, and a WOT ride still wins its own crowded course twice identically. FLOOR BOSS's SWING PAINT (#2627 s3) landed from slot a the same shift.
